title: Quantum & Advanced Compute
meta_description: Quantum & Advanced Compute services from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: Dataq Software's Quantum & Advanced Compute practice: what the tower covers, the services inside it, the platforms it deploys and the outcomes typical programs commit to.

Quantum & Advanced Compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. We deliver quantum readiness assessments, harvest-now-decrypt-later risk analysis, post-quantum cryptography migration programs, quantum and quantum-inspired optimization for routing, scheduling, portfolio and formulation problems, quantum machine learning pilots, and HPC engineering for simulation-heavy industries. Every roadmap separates near-term ROI from long-horizon positioning.

Two clocks are ticking: NIST's post-quantum standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) have started a multi-year migration clock for every enterprise holding long-lived secrets, while quantum and quantum-inspired optimization already delivers measurable wins in logistics, energy and finance. Leaders sequence both; laggards face a compressed, expensive scramble.

blocks.x: Anchor industries: Agriculture & Food Systems, Banking & Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Industrial, Public Sector & Government, Retail & Consumer Goods, Technology & SaaS, Telecom, Media & Entertainment.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.

A running record of the delta against baseline, updated at every gate, reviewed at every steering meeting.
